items.title: Hard to believe this was 10 years ago, before the MVP season. Feels like yesterday, feels like a lifetime.
items.author: Dan Devine
items.body_excerpt:
Hard to believe this was 10 years ago, before the MVP season. Feels like yesterday, feels like a lifetime.

"Winning isn't all that matters. It never was, and it never will be, not when raging against the dying of the light can be so beautiful." Mission statement!

sports.yahoo.com/russell-west...

images.alt:
Even if he can, and even if Westbrook is every ounce as incendiary an offensive force as we expect him to be, the Thunder might be drawing dead in a conference likely to be dominated by a Warriors squad that, with Durant in tow, is already breaking front offices' computer models. That's besides the point, though. Winning isn't all that matters. It never was, and it never will be, not when raging against the dying of the light can be so beautiful, so visceral, and so compelling.

Even when we think we know what's coming, we can still be surprised — see: Games 5 through 7 of both the Western Conference Finals and NBA Finals — and even when the result comes out the way we expected, the journey there can consist of all kinds of moments that thrill, that electrify, that make us feel alive. Few players in NBA history have provided those moments with as much sneer and style as Russell Westbrook, and now, the Thunder's fate rests on him providing as many as humanly possible. That's bad news for Oklahoma City's opponents, and really, really good news for the rest of us.

items.title: Hollander POTD Ennis Whatley. Alabama PG drafted 13th in 83. Had solid rookie yr (8 ppg 8 apg) but was let go. Bounced around (CLE,WAS,SA, LAC). He then did CBA/abroad for 3 yrs before getting back in NBA. Key backup to ATL in 93-94. Retired in 97, now a public speaker.

items.title: When I think about trans people in sports, I don’t think about lobbies or legislation.
items.author: Julia Poe
items.body_excerpt:
When I think about trans people in sports, I don’t think about lobbies or legislation.

I think about my friends.

Wrote about pick-up hoops, queer community and love:

media.title: Column: When I think about transgender people in sports, I think about my friends
media.description: Despite the rabid fixation upon the concept of trans women in sports, those who beat the drum the loudest for exclusive policies rarely seem to care about trans people themselves.
